rubric_content.text_property: The agent accurately grounds its responses in enterprise knowledge stores (Neo4j graph topologies, AlloyDB asset catalog metadata, past investigation memory notes, or RAG playbook guidelines) without hallucinating ungrounded infrastructure details.

rubrics.description: Checks grounding across enterprise knowledge planes.

rubric_content.text_property: The agent synthesizes raw telemetry and query results into actionable SOC intelligence, clearly highlighting asset criticality, lateral movement paths, past analyst hypotheses, or runbook remediation steps.

rubrics.description: Checks synthesis quality and actionable recommendations for SOC analysts.

rubric_content.text_property: The agent selects the appropriate tool or sub-agent for the inquiry: query_knowledge_graph for topological / lateral movement relationships, query_asset_catalog for asset criticality and owner metadata, query_investigation_memory for cross-session notes and hypotheses, and rag_knowledge_specialist for IRP playbooks and threat actor TTPs.

rubrics.description: Checks tool and sub-agent routing precision.
